messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — ACME POC hit a reproducible latency spike under concurrency. Need to lock success criteria + an escalation plan before tomorrow's exec check-in.

matt: Seen it in the canary logs earlier. p95 is fine but p99 jumps ~2.5x once we hit ~120 concurrent reqs.

anya: Can you paste the query profile? security questions incoming re: SLOs and fallbacks.

matt: snippet: ```
Requests/sec: 130
Model: gptx-6b-quant
p95: 180ms
p99: 760ms
Errors: 0.6% (mostly timeouts)
```

devon: For the POC acceptance we should keep it simple: latency, cost burn, and quality. Proposing: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms during provisioned load; total token spend < $1,500/week; eval pass rate >= 90% on the 200 prompt eval set. Thoughts?

anya: From security angle: need explicit fallback behavior documented — how we route to hosted vs dedicated, and whether logs contain PII. Also they want KMS + audit logs in scope for acceptance.

sara: ACME legal flagged KMS, but we promised a demo behind their VPC. We'll need Private deployment checklist for the run.

matt: Operationally, we can enforce fallback policy: if p99 > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes, switch to a smaller quantized variant (gptx-3b-q) and notify. Can we make that an acceptance/esc plan?

devon: Yes — include automatic canary rollback after 10m if quality drops >5% on golden prompts. Add manual escalation to oncall if degraded for >30m. Owner: @matt.

anya: Also require proof of data-at-rest encryption and KMS key ownership in the POC deliverables. Add a short Q/A doc for the SOC2/KMS bits.

sara: Timeline: finalize criteria today, run 2x 1-hour soak tests tomorrow (morning + afternoon), send results to ACME by EOD. If we pass, sales signs for Dedicated pilot next week. If we fail, we trigger the rollback and open a playbook ticket.

matt: I'll prep the eval harness and the 200-prompt set (will include edge-case prompts ACME gave us). Will add automated pass/fail script: 
```
# pass if: p99 <= 500 && eval_accuracy >= 0.9 && weekly_cost <= 1500
```

devon: Good. Add a small cost note: if we need burst capacity (overprovisioned GPUs) that will change the weekly spend estimate — call that out in the runbook.

anya: I'll draft the security appendix and KMS checklist in the doc and drop a link here when ready.

deploybot: deploybot: canary pipeline scheduled for 1901238600 — will run with 50% traffic at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

sara: Perfect. Action items: @matt -> run harness + create rollback playbook; @anya -> security appendix + KMS proof; @devon -> update runbook with cost/burst notes; me -> coordinate ACME communications. We'll reconvene 09:15 PT tomorrow to confirm readiness. :thumbsup:
